connector.name: Statistics of the World
connector.registryDescription: 490+ economic & demographic indicators for 218 countries from IMF, World Bank, UN, FRED.
connector.summary: Hosted at statisticsoftheworld.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.statisticsoftheworld, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Optional API key. Anonymous access is rate-limited to 1,000 requests/day per IP. Get a free key (same limit, usage dashboard) or upgrade to Pro/Business at https://statisticsoftheworld.com/pricing.
